rows.grounds: ṣaḍutthe = 'in the sixfold arising' (locative of compound ṣaṣ+uttha)
gandhapuṣpādyairgaṇeśaṃ = 'Gaṇeśa with fragrance, flowers, and so on' (compound: gandhapuṣpādi+instrumental plural + gaṇeśa accusative; sandhi/orthography ambiguous)
hyaiśagaṃ = 'indeed belonging to Īśāna' (hi + aiśāga/aiśāna-related form; sandhi and derivation ambiguous)
atthitaṃ = 'placed there' (past passive participle, accusative; form/lemma somewhat ambiguous)
vighnasaṃśāntyai = 'for the calming of obstacles' (tatpuruṣa compound vighna+saṃśānti, dative)
visarjayet = 'one should dismiss' (optative, causative-like form of √sṛj with vi)
